verdict.rationale: AutoGen documents AssistantAgent as a built-in agent with tool-use capability and mentions AgentTool for orchestration and MCP server tool integration, supporting the idea of quickly defining agents with tools; docs also cover custom agent creation. However, the evidence pack lacks a concrete short code example showing typed tool definitions (e.g., Python type hints auto-converted to schemas) or explicit mention of typed/structured tool signatures. missing for 10: a concrete minimal code sample demonstrating typed tool functions attached to an agent, explicit documentation of type-based schema inference, independent hands-on confirmation of ease-of-use.
